risks: Silent personal-to-team exposure if hydratePersonalTasksFrom's whole-bundle migration is reused in shared mode.
Dual writable authorities if shared replay coexists with personalTasksPut/Delete or direct PersonalTaskStore writes to shared IDs.
Hidden Task bootstrap gate: WP-04 supplies Project update, whereas WP-05 acceptance names Task editing before WP-11 canonical Task behavior.
WP-51 single-writer/fence is a published foundation gate but not an explicit WP-05 edge; lead must resolve ordering, not silently add dependencies or ignore it.
Three normative new paths are also WP-04 artifacts. Parallel recreation or competing ownership would overwrite accepted contracts/repositories.
Service migration path and generic Postgres-shaped columns do not settle client SQLite ownership/dialect; no fictitious cross-server/client transaction.
Batch schema does not yet constrain nested actions or per-command receipts; outer validation alone allows forged/unknown mutations and hides mixed rejections.
Boolean diff success can discard partial acceptance, mark a rejected draft synced, or overwrite persisted pending edits during hydration.
Cursor advanced before committed projection/inbox effect loses events; processing lease mistaken for processed ACK loses recovery; stale revision can resurrect revoked/tombstoned data.
Task edits are CAS revisioned commands, not CRDT. Multiple queued edits need accepted ordering/revision dependency semantics, not blind last-write wins or automatic conflict rebasing.
Execution PendingCommandsStore TTL/retention/owner decision is not domain idempotency, ACL or receipt evidence and must remain separate.
One personal corruption quarantine key cannot safely hold multiple revoked drafts or partition authenticated device/workspace data.
Native mutable refs must not require a provider account namespace merely because isRevisionedEntityRef is a remote-evidence helper.
Search/mentions/notifications/activity/agent completeness is a published conformance gate; missing downstream implementations are not N/A and helper/API fixtures are not native receipts.

Root may change inspected files concurrently. References are bounded to whole-file hashes and require refresh on drift; unobserved consumer/composition behavior is explicitly missing, not inferred as working.
